# Redesign Canvas

Redesign Canvas is a communication and design studio based in India, serving brands, governments, institutions, NGOs, and communities through design, storytelling, campaigns, documentary work, and social impact communication.

## Core Services

- Brand storytelling and identity design
- Campaign strategy and visual communication
- Documentary photography and film-led storytelling
- Social and behavioural change communication
- Learning, creative workshops, and communication strategy

## Important Pages

- Home: https://redesigncanvas.com/

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const cta = document.querySelector(".about-cta");
  const textElement = document.querySelector(".cta-text");
  const text = textElement.textContent;
  textElement.textContent = "";

  text.split("").forEach((char, index) => {
    const span = document.createElement("span");
    span.classList.add("letter");
    span.style.animationDelay = `${index * 0.05}s`;
    span.innerHTML = char === " " ? "&nbsp;" : char;
    textElement.appendChild(span);
  });

  // 🔥 Add intro animation class
  cta.classList.add("animate");

  // Remove animation class after animation ends
  setTimeout(() => {
    cta.classList.remove("animate");
  }, 1500);

});
</script>
